@@info: Prefer translating in your browser? Fink edits messages/ru.json directly — no code or git:
This file is the offline alternative.
Keys that exist in <en> but not in <ru>.
The values below are the en source text — replace them with ru translations.
You do not have to translate all of them; leave out what you are unsure about and open a PR.
A maintainer then runs 'npm run i18n:apply' to merge this file into messages/ru.json.
Anything still missing afterwards simply renders in en at runtime.
Plurals — ru uses the forms: one, few, many, other. "other" is required.
(add "plural": "total" to count another input instead of {count}).
Inside a sentence, # is the number: "Read {count, plural, one {# band} other {# bands}}"
An exact number like "=0": "No bands" beats the forms above.
equalizer_toggle_title: Turn the equalizer on or off
equalizer_filter_list_import_none: No valid filters found in file
equalizer_filter_list_graphic_fixed: The graphic EQ preset fixes the bands
equalizer_filter_list_band_limit: The EQ constraint allows no more bands
equalizer_autoeq_graphic_note: Fitting {count} fixed bands. Frequency and Q come from the preset, so only gain is optimized.
equalizer_player_filter_toggle_needs_eq: Turn the equalizer on to hear EQ in playback
equalizer_player_spectrum_toggle_title: Draw the playing audio's spectrum on the graph
equalizer_player_freq_select_title: Play only the band you drag on the graph
equalizer_device_peq_unreachable_off: The device's EQ is off. Turn it on first.
equalizer_device_peq_builtin: This built-in preset can't be written. Pick another preset under Device EQ to write.
equalizer_device_peq_status_saved_reconn: Saved. The device restarts after saving; reconnecting…

equalizer_device_peq_status_saved_reconn.one: Wrote {count} band. The device restarted to save and is connected again.
equalizer_device_peq_status_saved_reconn.other: Wrote {count} bands. The device restarted to save and is connected again.
